card.name: "in" after withdrawal in neonatal warnings
card.fires_on: The word "in" right after "can result in withdrawal" in the pregnancy warning about neonatal opioid withdrawal. It also fires weakly on a few other linking words (or, of, can) in label warnings.

modes.label: Withdrawal in the neonate
modes.description: The word "in" after "withdrawal" in the repeated opioid pregnancy warning sentence.
modes.example: during pregnancy can result in withdrawal<< in>> the neonate. Neonatal opioid withdrawal

modes.label: Other linking words
modes.description: Scattered linking words such as "or" or "of" in label warnings.
modes.example: If this drug is used during pregnancy,<< or>> if the patient becomes pregnant while taking this
